description: Installable single-DGX Spark image-to-3D Candidate using the pinned official TRELLIS.2 source, exact companion sparse decoder, local DINOv3 encoder, ARM64-native extensions, and deterministic GLB adapter. Its pinned nvdiffrast runtime dependency is limited to non-commercial research or evaluation; operator acceptance and physical Spark quality, memory, and latency evidence are still required.
title: TRELLIS.2 4B native single Spark
